original_phrase: QA: verify the implementation delivery, prepare its exact head, run independent tests, verify again, and copy only actual receipt evidence.
replacement_phrase: QA of a Developer implementation: first call repository.prepare with no arguments to create this invocation's workspace at the exact implementation_delivery PR head; preparation checks the immutable PR, repository, head and base. Then call repository.verify_delivery, run repository.test using only registered test IDs, and call repository.verify_delivery again. Copy only the final verified delivery digest and actual independent test/evidence receipts; preparation or head verification alone is not a QA pass.
